title: Steward + sensitive-records community-advisor outreach
context: The Hee-Lee Oss 'delivered, not merged' bar requires a named educational/historical/heritage steward that adopts, hosts, and cites the corpus before the project is considered shipped. Additionally, the sensitive-records track (enslavement-era and Indigenous records) requires a community advisor from a descendant community before that data can be extracted. Both seats are currently unstaffed, which blocks the project's final delivery and the sensitive-records track respectively. Outreach must begin in M0 so conversations are in progress by M1.
objective: Identify and initiate outreach to at least three candidate steward organizations (public libraries with genealogy special collections, university digital-humanities centers, state archives, genealogical societies, or African-American/Indigenous heritage organizations) and at least one candidate sensitive-records community advisor, documenting outreach status and any responses received.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 3 candidate steward organizations identified with rationale for why each qualifies (non-profit or public-interest, can publicly host or link the corpus, has a named contact).

At least 1 candidate sensitive-records community advisor identified from a descendant community (African-American genealogy/heritage organization or Indigenous data-governance body) relevant to enslavement-era and Indigenous US records.
Outreach initiated to all identified candidates; initial contact documented (date, channel, message summary).
Outreach status log committed as docs/partner-outreach-log.md with a table: organization, contact, date, channel, status (contacted/responded/declined/interested), and any response summary.

Minimum steward criteria documented (per PLAN.md: non-profit or public-interest; commits to publicly host or link; cites in at least one output; names a confirming contact; a lone individual or commercial reuser does not qualify).
output: docs/partner-outreach-log.md — outreach status log with candidate list, contacts, dates, and response summaries, committed via PR.
